name: c44-provenance-classification-review
argv:
import gzip, hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
audit = Path("/home/ray/developer/ai/math/audits/2026-10-07-m3-fresh-checkout")
clone = Path("/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447")
summary = json.loads((audit/"provenance-summary.json").read_bytes())
c44 = json.loads((audit/"c44-summary.json").read_bytes())
assert c44["suite_status"] == "FAIL" and c44["failed_checks"] == 1
assert c44["finding"]["id"] == "M3-C44-INPUT-AUDIT-001"
assert c44["finding"]["diagnostic"]["difference_count"] == 2
assert {d["path"] for d in c44["finding"]["diagnostic"]["differences"]} == {"$.layers[6].es_source_present", "$.layers[6].es_source_hash_matches"}
assert c44["finding"]["candidate_source_or_saved_artifact_repaired"] is False
assert [d["source"] for d in summary["historical_review_leaf_comparison"]] == ["artifacts/c5_excess_two_e4/reductions.json", "artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/controls.json", "artifacts/c5_excess_two_e4c/summary.json"]
branches = next(d for d in summary["comparisons"] if d["name"] == "E5_branches")
assert branches["strict_byte_status"] == "FAIL" and branches["exact_leaf_allowlist_match"]
assert branches["allowed_leaf_paths"] == ["/sources_sha256/docs/c5_excess_two_mixed_core_spokes.md"]
assert summary["new_finding"]["id"] == "M3-PROV-E5-BRANCHES"
assert all(entry["strict_byte_status"] == "FAIL" for entry in summary["comparisons"])
assert summary["strict_commands"]["e5_branches"]["exit_code"] == 1
whitespace = json.loads((audit/"whitespace-comparison.json").read_bytes())
historical = gzip.decompress((clone/"artifacts/c5_integrate_branch_review/logs/branch_whitespace.log.gz").read_bytes())
current = (audit/"logs/provenance_branch_whitespace.stdout.log").read_bytes()
assert historical == current
diagnostics = [line for line in current.decode().splitlines() if re.match(r"^(.+):(\d+): (.+)$",line)]
assert len(diagnostics) == whitespace["current_count"] == whitespace["historical_count"] == 86
assert whitespace["new_diagnostics"] == whitespace["resolved_diagnostics"] == []
for entry in whitespace["unchanged_exception_source_bytes"]:
    prior = subprocess.check_output(["git","show",summary["reference_review_sha"]+":"+entry["path"]],cwd=clone)
    candidate = subprocess.check_output(["git","show",summary["candidate_sha"]+":"+entry["path"]],cwd=clone)
    assert prior == candidate and hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == entry["candidate"]["sha256"]
assert whitespace["full_branch_exit_code"] == 2 and whitespace["candidate_parent_diff_exit_code"] == 0
md = (audit/"c44-summary.md").read_text()
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in md.splitlines())
print(json.dumps({"review_status":"PASS","c44_presence_drift":"separate candidate finding; original strict FAIL retained","e5_branches":"new document-hash finding; separate from three historical FAILs","branch_whitespace":{"diagnostics":86,"raw_identical_to_historical":True,"exception_source_files":len(whitespace["unchanged_exception_source_bytes"]),"full_branch_exit_code":2,"candidate_parent_diff_exit_code":0},"c44_summary_md":{"trailing_whitespace":0,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(md.encode()).hexdigest()}}))
